definitions.explanation: A specific aspect in which two or more things differ. Commonly used in academic, business, and analytical contexts when comparing items systematically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相違点|そういてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧。
examples.english: Let's organize the differences between the two proposals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{共通点|きょうつうてん}→共通点：03051_kyoutsuuten⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{相違点|そういてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please compare the similarities and differences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{相違点|そういてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are several major differences between the two countries' laws.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, analytical term often paired with ⟦{共通点|きょうつうてん}→共通点：03051_kyoutsuuten⟧ (common points, similarities) in comparisons. More formal than ⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ (difference).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相違点|そういてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧ (to list the differences)
- {相違点|そういてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あき}らかにする→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧ (to clarify the differences)
- ⟦{共通点|きょうつうてん}→共通点：03051_kyoutsuuten⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{相違点|そういてん} (similarities and differences)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧: difference — more casual and general
- ⟦{差異|さい}→差異：12411_sai⟧: difference, disparity — formal, emphasizes measurable gaps
- ⟦{共通点|きょうつうてん}→共通点：03051_kyoutsuuten⟧: common point — the counterpart used in comparisons
